hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */README.md|README.md|*/CLAUDE.md|CLAUDE.md|*/AGENTS.md|AGENTS.md|*/.claude/*|.claude/*|*/.gitignore|.gitignore) ;; *) mkdir -p .claude && touch .claude/.docs-update-pending ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

if [ -f .claude/.docs-update-pending ]; then rm -f .claude/.docs-update-pending; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Code/config changed this turn. Before finishing, update documentation (README.md, root CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md) and this repo'"'"'s Claude Code configuration (.claude/agents, .claude/skills) so they reflect the current state of the app."}'; fi
